name: Ground Floor Exit Width Check
description: Aggregate exit width at ground floor must satisfy maximum-floor occupant load
message: Ground floor exit width {value}m below required {threshold}m based on maximum floor occupant load. Widen exit discharge.

name: Fire Water Tank Capacity Check
description: Fire water storage must meet total demand over required duration
message: Fire water tank capacity {value}m³ below required {threshold}m³. Increase storage per hydrant and sprinkler demand.

name: Transformer Capacity Check
description: Installed transformer capacity must meet total building demand
message: Transformer capacity {value}kW below total building demand {threshold}kW. Upgrade or add transformer unit.

name: Emergency Power Duration Check
description: Emergency power supply duration must meet Fire Code requirement
message: Emergency power duration {value}min below required {threshold}min. Increase battery capacity or connect to standby generator.

name: Ramp Slope Check
description: Accessible ramp slope must not exceed 1:12
message: Ramp slope {value} exceeds the 1:12 (0.083) maximum for accessible routes. Redesign the ramp or provide a lift.
